tables.name: Environment
tables.description: Skipped for a Port, whose environment is Coastal or River. However it is placed, the town gets plentiful water somehow.

results.name: Coastal
results.description: The town is near a large body of water, such as a lake or ocean.

results.name: Forest
results.description: The town has been established in area cleared of the surrounding trees.

results.name: Mountains
results.description: The town is found on a plateaux of a stony pass or soaring peak.

results.name: Plains
results.description: The town is encircled by wide, open fields.

results.name: River
results.description: The town is near or built around a steadily flowing stream, or other watercourse.

results.name: Swamp
results.description: The town is in, or near, a vast area of stagnant water.

results.name: Underground
results.description: The town is within a vast network of caves.

results.name: Valley
results.description: The town is found within, or on the edge of, an area of recessed elevation in relation to the landscape around it.

results.name: Tundra
results.description: The town is in a very cold environment.

results.name: Desert
results.description: The town is in a dry and arid environment, likely flanked by vast sand dunes.
